productSummary.oneSentenceSummary: ContentGate is a WordPress plugin that restricts access to pages, posts, or entire sites based on user login status, role, and other conditions.
productSummary.whatItDoes: ContentGate allows WordPress site owners to control who can view their content by creating visual access rules without coding. It supports restricting individual pages, posts, or entire websites based on user roles, login status, registration date, and other criteria.

features.name: Visual Rule Builder
features.description: Create access restriction rules using a visual interface without writing code. Build conditional logic like 'IF visitor is logged out → hide this page.'
evidence: Make rules like "IF visitor is logged out → hide this page." Build complex logic visually with zero code.
No shortcodes, no PHP, no headaches

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Restrict content based on WordPress user roles including Contributors, Editors, Admins, or any custom roles.
evidence: Target specific WordPress user roles — Contributors, Editors, Admins, or any custom role you've created.
Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.

features.name: Login Status Restrictions
features.description: Control content visibility based on whether a visitor is logged in or logged out.
evidence: Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.
Make rules like "IF visitor is logged out → hide this page."

features.name: Instant Rule Activation
features.description: Toggle access rules on or off in real-time without modifying theme files or functions.php.
evidence: Toggle any rule on or off instantly. Test restrictions in real-time without touching theme files or functions.php.
Toggle the rule on. Your content is now protected — instantly, reliably, beautifully.

features.name: Custom Restriction Messages
features.description: Display fully editable messages to visitors when they don't have access to restricted content.
evidence: Add fully editable message that visitors see when they don't have access to a post or page.
Write the message visitors see when they're restricted. Brand it, link it, make it yours.

features.name: Whole Site Lock
features.description: Apply a single access rule to protect the entire WordPress site at once.
evidence: Put your entire WordPress site behind a single access rule. Only approved users can view anything at all.
Select specific pages, posts, or toggle on "Whole Site" to protect everything at once.

features.name: Granular Content Protection
features.description: Restrict individual pages, posts, or the entire website with flexible control over each piece of content.
evidence: From a single blog post to your entire website — ContentGate gives you granular control over every piece of content.
Hide any page you want. Perfect for private lessons, dashboards, or client pages.
Keep certain blog posts private so only the right people can read them.

features.name: Registration Date Filtering
features.description: Restrict content based on user registration date.
evidence: Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.

useCases.title: Private Pages
useCases.description: Create private pages for lessons, dashboards, or client-specific content that only authorized users can access.

useCases.title: Member Content
useCases.description: Restrict blog posts and content to members only, keeping premium content private for the right audience.

useCases.title: Exclusive Sites
useCases.description: Lock down an entire website so only approved users can view any content.

useCases.title: Online Course
useCases.description: Protect course materials and lessons behind access rules for enrolled students.

useCases.title: Private Forum
useCases.description: Restrict forum access to specific user roles or logged-in members.

howTos.title: Set Up Content Restriction
steps: Install the Plugin: Download and activate ContentGate from the WordPress plugin directory
Create what to Protect: Use the visual rule builder to define your condition (e.g., user login status and user role)
Choose what to Protect: Select specific pages, posts, or toggle on 'Whole Site' to protect everything at once
Customize the Message: Write the message visitors see when they're restricted
Activate & Done: Toggle the rule on to protect your content instantly
